change.data: the v5 store, as built (no rebuild).
change.sampling: tools/genfill_v5_weights.py writes <store>/sampling_v5.json once (rules fixed in the tool, sha256 recorded by the trainer). Each training clip's draw weight = v4.2's structure weight x theme factor x edge factor. Theme factor: the largest of its themes' (door 2, glare 2, practical 1.5, thin 1.5, window 1.25, sun 0.5, sky 0.5; none 1). Edge factor: 2 where frame 0 has 30 or more thin dark pixels (no wider than 6 px, 3 stops or more below the region's median) within 8 px outside the mask, else 1. Expected share of draws (train), structure weight only -> v5: sun 31 -> 25 %, sky 18 -> 6 %, door 9 -> 16 %, practical 14 -> 20 %, thin 18 -> 25 %, window 11 -> 18 %, glare 1.5 -> 2.3 %; clips with a thin edge 48 -> 70 %.
change.dev_monitor: --dev-pick spread (32 clips evenly through the dev set, not its first 32); the 39 dev clips of the 9 crossed scenes left out (sampling_v5.json dev_monitor false). A monitor only: nothing is selected on it.
change.trainer: training/genfill_train.py: --clip-weights and --dev-pick (defaults leave v1-v4.2 runs exactly as they were). Tests: tests/test_genfill_v5_train.py.
change.left_out: tools/genfill_v5_weights.py BROKEN_SCENES: those 9 scenes' 27 clips get weight 0 and stay out of the dev monitor (sampling_v5.json left_out). tools/blender/genfill_v5_scenes.py now keeps each frame's Euler angles closest to the previous frame's (later renders); test_genfill_v5.py checks a pan across +-180 degrees of yaw. The store is not rebuilt.
